about_the_game:
OVERVIEW

You and your crew take shared control of a vehicle, driving helpless passengers across a dangerous wasteland filled with zombies, bandits, and monsters.

If you deliver them safely, you get paid! Use that money to upgrade your guns and vehicle and be a better taxi service.

Work together to increase the number of passengers you drop off before your vehicle breaks down and you have to start over from scratch.

All in the world of Tombstone Taxi!

FEATURING

4-PLAYER COUCH CO-OP
Gather your crew and head out to fight zombies, bandits, and more while you take people from Crescent Ridge or the Outposts to Spirowood!

Each player gets to choose which crew member they want to while out in the wasteland.

SHARE ONE VEHICLE

Someone drives.

Someone shoots.

And someone yells from the back while NOBODY IS DOING THEIR JOB RIGHT?! CMON! HURRY UP BOB!!! SHOOT 'EM!

Take shared control of a single vehicle and navigate as a team.

DELIVER PASSENGERS FOR MONEY

Use money earned from taxiing passengers to upgrade weapons and vehicles for more explosive action!

So go visit Jerry's shop and he might be able to craft you something brand spanking new.

GAIN TEMPORARY POWERUPS

Boost your Taxi's power with upgrades out in the field and from Wanda's shop in the Outposts. Sadly, the Chief hasn't found a way to retain that power between trips so you'll need to re-acquire those powerups every time.

SURVIVE THE WASTELAND

It’s a constant turf war between the bandits and monsters, so the land is always in flux, you never know what the day will bring.

Zombies. Skeletons. Bandit gangs!! Scorpion men? Walking bombs?! Radation-spewing-leech-crawler-3-legged mutation?!? Yuck. It's gonna be a tough ride. Buckle up back there!

DEFEAT THE BOSS

Just when you thought it was over... The wasteland doubles down on its threats.

Can you work together well? Or will your vehicle break down and have you starting over from scratch?
